ToyBox_Features_Achievements_BrowseAchie.Original: Once a save is loaded, this allows looking through a list of achievements, supporting inspecting and unlocking them.
ToyBox_Features_Achievements_BrowseAchie.Translated: 载入存档后，可浏览成就列表，并查看或解锁成就。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Allow.Original: Enable Mouse3 Dragging To Aim The Camera
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Allow.Translated: 允许鼠标中键拖动来调整相机

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Allow.Original: Allows orbiting the camera while holding down Mouse Wheel.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Allow.Translated: 按住鼠标中键时可环绕旋转镜头。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Allow.Original: Enable Rotate on all maps and cutscenes
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Allow.Translated: 在所有地图和过场动画中启用视角旋转

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Allow.Original: Note: For cutscenes and some situations the rotation keys are disabled so you have to hold down Mouse3 to drag in order to get rotation
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Allow.Translated: 注意：在过场动画和某些场景中，旋转按键会被禁用；此时需按住鼠标中键并拖动才能旋转镜头。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Allow.Original: Enable Zoom on all maps and cutscenes
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Allow.Translated: 在所有地图和过场动画中启用视角缩放

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Allow.Original: Makes CameraController always allow zoom and ignore ZoomLock.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Allow.Translated: 使 CameraController 始终允许缩放，并忽略 ZoomLock。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Camer.Original: Adds a flat modifier to the height of the camera above the ground.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Camer.Translated: 对镜头离地高度应用固定偏移值。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_DragC.Original: Press CTRL while rotating camera to change height
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_DragC.Translated: 旋转镜头时按住 CTRL 调整高度

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_DragC.Original: CTRL + Mouse3 to adjust camera height
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_DragC.Translated: CTRL + 鼠标中键：调整镜头高度

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_FOVMu.Original: Changes the min/max FoV (you can scroll further in and out)
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_FOVMu.Translated: 调整最小/最大视野范围（可进一步拉近或拉远）。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_FreeC.Original: Makes the game no longer force the camera to ground.

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Reset.Original: Resets the camera perspective to what it was before orbiting it.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Camera_Reset.Translated: 将镜头视角重置为环绕旋转前的状态。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Compl.Original: This allows doing Infinite Actions per turn.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Compl.Translated: 每回合可执行无限次行动。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Equip.Original: Allows changing your equipment while in combat.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Equip.Translated: 允许在战斗中更换装备。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Highl.Original: Highlights objects even if they would normally be hidden by a perception Check or otherwise. Optionally also highlight objects in Fog Of War and hidden traps.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Highl.Translated: 高亮通常会因察觉检定等原因而隐藏的物体；还可选择高亮战争迷雾中的物体和隐藏陷阱。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Highl.Original: Also Highlight in Fog of War
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Highl.Translated: 同时高亮战争迷雾中的物体

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Ignor.Original: Ignore all Target Requirements for Abilities
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Ignor.Translated: 忽略能力的所有目标要求

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Ignor.Original: Always allows using abilities regardless of target restrictions like Line of Sight, Friendly Fire or something else.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Ignor.Translated: 无视视线、友军伤害等目标限制，始终允许使用能力。
忽略能力要求：范围效果重叠

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Ignor.Original: Allows equipping items regardless of class, stat, etc. requirements.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Ignor.Translated: 无视职业、属性等要求，允许装备任意物品。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Ignor.Original: Ignore Ability Requirements - Line of Sight

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Ignor.Translated: 忽略能力要求：目标过近
忽略能力要求：目标过远

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Infin.Original: Prevents charges on usable items from being spent.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Infin.Translated: 使用可用物品时不消耗其使用次数。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Insta.Original: Restores Item charges and rests Units once the party leaves combat.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Insta.Translated: 队伍脱离战斗后，恢复物品使用次数并使所有单位休整。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Parti.Original: Don't use any AP except for except for abilities which would consume all your AP at once.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Parti.Translated: 除会一次性消耗全部 AP 的能力外，其他行动均不消耗 AP。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Preve.Original: Entering a trap zone while having traps disabled will prevent that trap from triggering even if you deactivate this option in the future.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Preve.Translated: 启用时进入陷阱区域会使该陷阱不再触发；即使日后关闭此选项，该陷阱仍不会恢复触发。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Resto.Original: Restore Spells and Skills after Combat
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Resto.Translated: 战斗后恢复法术与技能

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Resto.Original: Restores all ability resources once the party leaves combat.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Resto.Translated: 队伍脱离战斗后，恢复所有能力资源。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Unlim.Original: Makes modifiers like Stats or Damage stack for party members even if they shouldn't.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Cheats_Unlim.Translated: 允许队伍成员的属性、伤害等调整值无限叠加，即使正常情况下不应叠加。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_Immor.Original: Applies a buff to the selected units which makes them immortal.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_Immor.Translated: 为所选单位添加使其不会死亡的状态效果。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_KillA.Original: Kills all enemies that are currently in combat with you.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_KillA.Translated: 杀死当前与玩家交战的所有敌人。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_Lobot.Original: Makes enemies unable to act, move and perform attack of opportunities.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_Lobot.Translated: 使敌人无法行动、移动或发动借机攻击。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_Murde.Original: When enabled, enemies will be killed when they join combat.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_Murde.Translated: 启用后，敌人一进入战斗便会被杀死。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_Remov.Original: Removes all non-hidden and non-persistent buffs from all party members and pets.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_Remov.Translated: 移除所有队伍成员与宠物身上非隐藏、非永久的状态效果。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_RestA.Original: Revives and heals all characters + restores action points, ability cooldowns and item charges.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_RestA.Translated: 复活并治疗所有角色，同时恢复行动点、能力冷却和物品使用次数。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_RestS.Original: Revives and heals the selected characters + restores action points and ability cooldowns.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Combat_RestS.Translated: 复活并治疗所选角色，同时恢复行动点和能力冷却。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_Chang.Original: Opens the party member selection screen.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_Chang.Translated: 打开队伍成员选择界面。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_Chang.Original: Sets the time until next weather change to 0.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_Chang.Translated: 将距离下次天气变化的时间设为 0。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_GiveA.Original: Adds 1 of each BlueprintItem to the player inventory.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_GiveA.Translated: 向玩家物品栏中添加每种 BlueprintItem 各 1 件。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_GoToG.Original: Tries to load the sector map area. Don't use in prologue.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_GoToG.Translated: 尝试载入星区地图区域。请勿在序章中使用。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_OpenR.Original: Opens the faction reputation trade window (when available).
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_OpenR.Translated: 在可用时打开阵营声望交易窗口。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_Rerol.Original: Resets the saved results of awareness rolls on map objects.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_Rerol.Translated: 重置地图物体已保存的察觉检定结果。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_Reset.Original: Re-enables skill checks on interactable objects in the area.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Common_Reset.Translated: 重新启用当前区域内可交互物体的技能检定。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_ExCom.Original: Include Ex-Companions In Remote Companion Dialog
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_ExCom.Translated: 在远程同伴对话中包含离队同伴

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_ExCom.Original: This makes Remote Companion Dialog also include companions who left the party.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_ExCom.Translated: 使远程同伴对话也包含已经离队的同伴。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_Ignor.Translated: 忽略对话限制（全部，实验性）

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_Ignor.Original: Answers that were restricted will be made available.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_Ignor.Translated: 使原本受限的回答可供选择。
忽略对话限制（灵魂印记）

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_Ignor.Original: Answers that were restricted based on your conviction/soul marks will be made available.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_Ignor.Translated: 使因信念/灵魂印记限制而不可用的回答可供选择。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_Jealo.Original: Allow multiple romances at the same time
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_Jealo.Translated: 允许同时发展多段恋情

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_LoveI.Original: Allow any gender for any Romance.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_LoveI.Translated: 允许任意性别与任意恋爱对象发展关系。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_Overr.Original: Make the game recognize you as e.g. having the Sanctioned Psyker instead of whatever you actually picked.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_Overr.Translated: 让游戏将你的剧情职业识别为指定选项，例如“受制裁灵能者”，而非实际选择的职业。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_Remot.Original: Expand Dialog To Include Remote Companions
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_Remot.Translated: 扩展对话以包含远程同伴

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_Remot.Original: Allow remote companions to make comments on dialog you are having.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Dialog_Remot.Translated: 允许未在当前队伍中的同伴对正在进行的对话发表评论。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_DiceRolls_Di.Original: Allows changing the results of various dice rolls across the game.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_DiceRolls_Di.Translated: 允许修改游戏中多种掷骰的结果。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_DiceRolls_Di.Original: Advantage means doing two rolls and taking the better result; which for Initiative and Damage rolls means the higher number and for Skill Checks the lower number.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_DiceRolls_Di.Translated: 优势表示掷骰两次并取较优结果：先攻和伤害掷骰取较高值，技能检定取较低值。
先攻 → 数值越高越好
技能检定 → 数值越低越好
伤害 → 数值越高越好
攻击掷骰 → 数值越低越好

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_DiceRolls_Di.Original: Controls whether attacks made by the selected units are redirected to cover instead of their target.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_DiceRolls_Di.Translated: 控制所选单位的攻击是否被重定向到掩体而非其目标。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_EnemyStatMod.Original: Allows adding flat stat boosts to enemies, e.g. Enemy Health +20.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_EnemyStatMod.Translated: 为敌人属性添加固定加值，例如敌人生命值 +20。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_EnemyStatMod.Original: Allows adding stat multipliers, e.g. Enemy Health x3.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_EnemyStatMod.Translated: 为敌人属性应用倍率，例如敌人生命值 ×3。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_ExperienceMu.Original: Provides a general experience multiplier and possible overrides for specific kinds of experience sources.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_ExperienceMu.Translated: 提供通用经验倍率，并可针对特定经验来源单独覆盖。
技能检定经验单独设置
太空战斗经验单独设置

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_OtherMultipl.Original: Manage Exceptions to Buff Duration Multiplier
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_OtherMultipl.Translated: 管理状态效果持续时间倍率的例外项
状态效果持续时间倍率

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_OtherMultipl.Original: Multiplies the duration of buffs assuming they are not excluded and not casted by an enemy.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_OtherMultipl.Translated: 对未被排除且并非由敌人施放的状态效果应用持续时间倍率。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_OtherMultipl.Original: Adjusts how far of your character you can click and still cause your character to walk instead of run.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_OtherMultipl.Translated: 调整点击位置距角色多远时仍会步行而非奔跑。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_OtherMultipl.Original: Adjusts how far of your character you have to click and still cause your character to spring. If this area overlaps with walk distance then this has priority.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_OtherMultipl.Translated: 调整点击位置距角色多远时会触发冲刺。若与步行距离范围重叠，则以本设置为准。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_OtherMultipl.Original: Adjusts the movement speed of your party in area maps.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_OtherMultipl.Translated: 调整队伍在区域地图中的移动速度。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Preview_Dial.Translated: 灵魂印记 {0} 偏移 {1}——说明：{2}

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Preview_Prev.Original: Shows conditions of answers in dialog.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Preview_Prev.Translated: 显示对话回答的触发条件。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Preview_Prev.Original: Shows results of cues and answers in dialog.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_Preview_Prev.Translated: 显示对话节点和回答的结果。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Auto load Last Save on launch
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 启动时自动加载最新存档

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Hold down shift during launch to bypass.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 启动时按住 Shift 可跳过。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Click to Transfer Entire Stack
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 单击转移整组物品

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Enabling this will let you do KEYBIND + Click an item to shift its entire stack.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 启用后，可用“快捷键 + 单击”一次转移整组物品。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Disable End Turn Hotkey
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 禁用结束回合快捷键

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Disables the base game end turn hotkey.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 禁用游戏原有的结束回合快捷键。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Allow Achievements While Using Mods
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 使用 MOD 时仍可解锁成就

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: This is intended for you to be able to enjoy the game while using mods that enhance your quality of life.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 旨在让你在使用便利类 MOD 的同时正常体验游戏。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Fix Incorrect Main Character
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 修正主角识别错误

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Certain situations might cause the game to incorrectly assume someone else is the main character. This tries to restore the original main character.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 某些情况下，游戏可能错误地将其他角色认定为主角；此功能会尝试恢复原始主角。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Alternate Game Time Scale
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 备用游戏时间倍率

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Optional alternate time scale which can be swapped to via hotkey.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 可通过快捷键切换的备用时间倍率。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Game Time Scale
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 游戏时间倍率

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Speeds up or slows down the entire game (movement, animation, everything)
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 加速或减速整个游戏（移动、动画、一切）

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Enable Loading with Blueprint Errors
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 允许在蓝图（Blueprint）错误时加载存档

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: This feature allows loading saves even with missing blueprint mods, which can be dangerous. This can potentially allow you to recover a save, though you'll have to respec at minimum.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 即使缺少蓝图 MOD 也允许加载存档，存在风险。此功能可能帮助恢复存档，但至少需要重新训练角色。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Object Highlight Toggle Mode
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 物体高亮切换模式

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Turns the object highlight key into a toggle (press to switch) outside of combat.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 将战斗外的物体高亮键改为切换模式（按一次开启或关闭）。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Refill Belt Consumables
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 自动补充腰带消耗品

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Automatically refill consumables in belt slots if there are some in your inventory.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 物品栏中有同类物品时，自动补充腰带栏位中的消耗品。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: Skip Splash Screen
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 跳过启动画面

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Original: This skips the splash screen that appears when the game starts. Helpful if you need to frequently restart the game.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_QualityOfLif.Translated: 跳过游戏启动时显示的启动画面，适合需要频繁重启游戏时使用。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_C.Original: Customize Psychic Phenomena / Perils of the Warp
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_C.Translated: 自定义灵能现象/亚空间危害

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_C.Original: Allows disabling specific psychic phenomenas or perils of the warp.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_C.Translated: 允许禁用特定灵能现象或亚空间危害。
刷新可用灵能现象/危害（用于 MOD 兼容）

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_D.Original: Prevents random encounters in warp. Note that this also disables positive and flavor events!
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_D.Translated: 阻止亚空间中的随机遭遇。注意：这也会禁用正面事件和氛围事件！

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_M.Original: Allows you to modify the reputation at the various in-game factions.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_M.Translated: 允许修改游戏中各阵营的声望。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_M.Original: Adjust Reputation by the following amount
Allows modifying Scrap, Profit Factor, Navigators Insight and possibly current Veil Thickness.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_M.Translated: 允许修改废料、利润因素、导航员洞察力，可能还包括当前帷幕厚度。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_M.Original: Adjust Navigator Insight by the following amount
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_M.Translated: 按以下数值调整导航员洞察力

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_M.Original: Adjust Scrap by the following amount
Adjust Profit Factor by the following amount
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_M.Translated: 按以下数值调整利润因素

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_M.Original: Set Veil Thickness to the following amount
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_M.Translated: 将帷幕厚度设为以下数值

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_P.Original: Prevents Psyker Abilities from causing any kind of psychic phenomena. This includes e.g. the Dark Prayer ability and Chaos Sword.
ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_P.Translated: 防止灵能者能力引发任何灵能现象，包括“黑暗祈祷”能力和“混沌之剑”等。

ToyBox_Features_BagOfTricks_RTSpecific_P.Original: Forces the current veil thickness to 0.

ToyBox_Features_LevelUp_RespecFromLevelX.Original: If a unit is respecced while this feature is enabled and the feature (or ToyBox) is later disabled, minor level-up UI glitches may occur. During level-up the game uses a base (original) copy of the unit. ToyBox must respec that copy when it's created (which only happens while the feature is active). If this is not done, there can be slight issues like the game thinking you have a feature despite not having it (because the base/original unit was supposed to have that feature, making the new copy having it too). This is not a hard dependency as any issues can be fixed by respeccing the unit after disabling this feature/ToyBox.
ToyBox_Features_LevelUp_RespecFromLevelX.Translated: 如果在此功能启用时重新训练单位，随后又关闭该功能或 ToyBox，升级界面可能出现轻微异常。升级时，游戏会使用该单位的基础（原始）副本；ToyBox 必须在该副本创建时对其重新训练，而这只会在功能启用时发生。若未完成，可能出现游戏误认为你拥有某项特性等问题（因为基础/原始单位本应拥有该特性，新副本也会继承）。这并非硬性依赖；关闭此功能或 ToyBox 后，再次重新训练单位即可修复。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Translated: 影响每个线程一次加载的蓝图数量。数值越低，负载均衡越好，但同步开销越大。
分片数量

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Original: This affects the amount of dictionaries that will be used to reduce synchronization overhead when threaded loading.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Translated: 影响用于降低多线程加载同步开销的字典数量。
线程数量

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Original: This affects the amount of threads that will be used to simultaneously load blueprints. Larger is not necessarily better.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Translated: 影响同时加载蓝图的线程数。数量越多不一定越好。
启用 BlueprintId 缓存

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Original: When enabled, ToyBox will create a cache for ids of different blueprint types. Certain menus like Search 'n Pick will then try to load only blueprints of the specified type (e.g. BlueprintFeature), thereby speeding up load times.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Translated: 启用后，ToyBox 会为不同蓝图类型的 ID 创建缓存。“搜索与选取”等菜单会尝试只加载指定类型的蓝图（例如 BlueprintFeature），从而缩短加载时间。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Original: Reset BlueprintId Cache (in case of issues)
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Translated: 重置 BlueprintId 缓存（出现问题时）
性能优化
提升蓝图加载性能
预加载蓝图

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Original: Always load all Blueprints on game Start. This increases initial load times and RAM usage, but can decrease game loading times once finished.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Translated: 游戏启动时始终加载全部蓝图。这会增加初始加载时间和内存占用，但完成后可缩短游戏内加载时间。
显示蓝图 AssetGUID

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Original: Whether Browsers should display the asset id of a blueprint.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Translated: 是否在浏览器中显示蓝图的资源 ID。
显示蓝图类型

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Original: Whether Browsers should display the type of a blueprint.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Translated: 是否在浏览器中显示蓝图类型。
同时显示显示名与内部名

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Original: Blueprints have both internal names and display names. By default, ToyBox will try to show the Display name and fall back to the Internal one in case of issues. This feature will display both at the same time.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Translated: 蓝图同时具有内部名称和显示名称。ToyBox 默认优先显示显示名称，出现问题时回退为内部名称；此功能会同时显示两者。
启用多线程蓝图加载器（需要重启！）

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Original: Massively speeds up blueprint loading; but can have very rare bugs (especially after updates).
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Bluepri.Translated: 可大幅加快蓝图加载，但极少数情况下可能出现错误（尤其是在更新后）。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Browser.Original: Restricts the amount of items a page of a list/browser can display
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Browser.Translated: 限制列表/浏览器每页可显示的项目数量。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Browser.Original: Automatically start a new search after a configurable delay even while you are typing
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Browser.Translated: 即使仍在输入，也会在可配置的延迟后自动开始新搜索。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Browser.Original: This is the time in seconds that is waited before a new search is automatically started
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Browser.Translated: 自动开始新搜索前等待的秒数。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Browser.Original: Also search through the descriptions of blueprints

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Game_CopyLoc.Original: Hotkey to copy location to clipboard
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Game_CopyLoc.Translated: 复制位置到剪贴板的快捷键

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Game_CopyLoc.Original: [ToyBox] Failed to copy location: No hit for raycast.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Game_CopyLoc.Translated: [ToyBox] 复制位置失败：射线检测未命中。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Game_Display.Translated: 在大多数工具提示中显示 GUID

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Game_Display.Original: Displays the guids of the items etc. in their tooltips and allows copying them by pressing LMB + Hotkey.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Game_Display.Translated: 在物品等对象的工具提示中显示 GUID，并可按“鼠标左键 + 快捷键”复制。
已将 GUID 复制到剪贴板：

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Game_EnableG.Original: This turns on the developer console which lets you access cheat commands, access a console and more.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Game_EnableG.Translated: 启用开发者控制台，可使用作弊命令、访问控制台等功能。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Original: Limits the amount of items/rows that are drawn to prevent freezing the ui. Items exceeding the limit are discarded.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Translated: 限制绘制的项目/行数，防止界面卡死；超出上限的项目会被丢弃。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Original: Amount of space that is indented for each nested level in the inspector
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Translated: 检查器每一级嵌套的缩进空间。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Original: The fraction of the screen width the name part of inspector takes (0.3 means 30%).
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Translated: 检查器中名称部分占屏幕宽度的比例（0.3 表示 30%）。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Original: Lower numbers mean less ui lag during search but longer search time.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Translated: 数值越低，搜索时界面卡顿越少，但搜索时间越长。
显示编译器生成的字段

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Original: Show fields that are marked as compiler generated in Inspector (e.g. backing fields of properties)
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Translated: 在检查器中显示被标记为编译器生成的字段（例如属性的后备字段）。
显示可枚举对象的其他字段

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Original: Whether to also show other fields besides the actual collection items of IEnumerable types.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Translated: 对 IEnumerable 类型，是否除集合项目外同时显示其他字段。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Original: Show members that are null or empty
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Translated: 显示为 null 或空的成员

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Original: Shows Fields/Properties that are either null or an empty collection
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Translated: 显示值为 null 或空集合的字段/属性。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Original: Whether to show static members of types.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Translated: 是否显示类型的静态成员。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Original: If you hate whitespace and alignment
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Inspector_In.Translated: 适合不喜欢留白和对齐的用户。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Charact.Original: Modifies the range for the Nearby Character Picker category
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_Charact.Translated: 调整“附近角色”选择分类的范围。

ToyBox_Features_FontFix_FontFixFeature_D.Original: There is a Unity bug that causes some systen fonts to become weird in IMGUI (the mod GUI). This feature fixes that.
ToyBox_Features_FontFix_FontFixFeature_D.Translated: Unity 存在一个错误，会导致部分系统字体在 IMGUI（MOD 界面）中显示异常；此功能可修复该问题。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_GlyphS.Original: ToyBox uses some non-ascii characters (▼ ▶ ✎ ✔ ✖) in its UI. If the game font can't render them, ToyBox falls back to plain ASCII.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_GlyphS.Translated: ToyBox 界面使用部分非 ASCII 字符（▼ ▶ ✎ ✔ ✖）。若游戏字体无法显示，会回退为普通 ASCII 字符。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_GlyphS.Original: Probe the game font on the first UI frame and pick glyphs or ASCII automatically.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_GlyphS.Translated: 在界面首次绘制时检测游戏字体，并自动选择特殊字形或 ASCII 字符。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_GlyphS.Original: Off falls back to plain ASCII. Only used when auto-detect is disabled.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_GlyphS.Translated: 关闭后回退为普通 ASCII 字符。仅在禁用自动检测时生效。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_ImguiC.Original: A Unity Engine Update somehow switched the Color Space of the Mod UI, making colors look washed out. This is a bandaid fix for that issue.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_ImguiC.Translated: Unity 引擎更新改变了 MOD 界面的色彩空间，导致颜色发白；此选项是针对该问题的临时修复。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_LazyIn.Original: The mod tries to speed up initial game load time by only doing important initialization on the main thread and doing the rest on a separate thread.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_LazyIn.Translated: MOD 仅在主线程执行重要初始化，其余工作转移到独立线程，以缩短游戏初始加载时间。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_LogHotk.Original: When ticked this shows ToyBox commands in the combat log which is helpful for you to know when you used the shortcut.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_LogHotk.Translated: 勾选后，在战斗日志中显示 ToyBox 指令，便于确认何时触发了快捷键。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_LogLeve.Original: Decides what type of messages get written to the log file.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_LogLeve.Translated: 决定哪些类型的信息会写入日志文件。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_ShowRi.Original: ToyBox hides some options by default. Activating this will unhide those features.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_ShowRi.Translated: ToyBox 默认隐藏部分选项；启用后将显示这些功能。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_TB1Set.Original: Imports settings from an installed ToyBox 1 (the Settings.xml in its mod folder) into ToyBox 2. Settings whose meaning changed or that no longer exist are skipped.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_TB1Set.Translated: 从已安装的 ToyBox 1（其 MOD 文件夹中的 Settings.xml）导入设置到 ToyBox 2。含义已改变或已不存在的设置会被跳过。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_TB1Set.Original: Imported {0} settings from ToyBox 1. Restart the game so every change takes full effect.
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_TB1Set.Translated: 已从 ToyBox 1 导入 {0} 项设置。请重启游戏，使所有更改完全生效。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_TB1Set.Original: Also imported {0} save-specific settings from the loaded save (quick save and then load the new save for chanes to take effect).
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_TB1Set.Translated: 还从已载入的存档导入了 {0} 项存档专属设置（快速存档后载入新存档，更改方可生效）。

ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_TB1Set.Original: Load a ToyBox 1 save and import again to also bring over its save-specific settings (unit size / AI overrides / skeleton changes).
ToyBox_Features_SettingsTab_Other_TB1Set.Translated: 请载入一个 ToyBox 1 存档后再次导入，以同时迁移其存档专属设置（单位尺寸/AI 覆盖/骨骼修改）。

ToyBox_Features_UpdateAndIntegrity_Updat.Original: Check the integrity of ToyBox files
ToyBox_Features_UpdateAndIntegrity_Updat.Translated: 检查 ToyBox 文件的完整性
尝试重新安装当前版本

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_UpdateA.Original: Reinstall the current mod version or update to the latest available version
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_UpdateA.Translated: 重新安装当前 MOD 版本，或更新到最新可用版本。

ToyBox_Features_UpdateAndIntegrity_Versi.Original: Check whether the current mod version is compatible with the current game version
ToyBox_Features_UpdateAndIntegrity_Versi.Translated: 检查当前 MOD 版本是否与当前游戏版本兼容

ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_UpdateA.Original: Mod Version is not compatible with this game version!
ToyBox_Features_SettingsFeatures_UpdateA.Translated: MOD 版本与当前游戏版本不兼容！

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Tries to colonize the specified BlueprintColony in the current Star System.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 尝试在当前星系中殖民指定的殖民地蓝图（BlueprintColony）。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Tries to colonize the specified BlueprintPlanet in the current Star System.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 尝试在当前星系中殖民指定的行星蓝图（BlueprintPlanet）。
载入指定的区域预设蓝图（BlueprintAreaPreset）。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Gets the first AreaEnterPoint corresponding to the specified BlueprintArea and loads it.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 获取指定区域蓝图（BlueprintArea）对应的第一个区域入口点并载入。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Loads the area of the specified BlueprintAreaEnterPoint.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 载入指定区域入口点（BlueprintAreaEnterPoint）所在的区域。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Gets the first AreaEnterPoint corresponding to the specified BlueprintSectorMapPointStarSystem and loads it.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 获取指定星区地图星系点位（BlueprintSectorMapPointStarSystem）对应的第一个区域入口点并载入。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Gets the first AreaEnterPoint corresponding to the specified BlueprintStarSystemMap and loads it.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 获取指定星系地图（BlueprintStarSystemMap）对应的第一个区域入口点并载入。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Adds the specified BlueprintItem to your inventory.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 将指定的物品蓝图（BlueprintItem）添加到你的物品栏。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Removes the specified BlueprintItem from your inventory.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 从你的物品栏移除指定的物品蓝图（BlueprintItem）。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Increases or decreases the value of the specified BlueprintUnlockableFlag.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 增加或减少指定可解锁标志（BlueprintUnlockableFlag）的值。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Complete the specified BlueprintEtude. A failed Etude is often used to mark a failed quest state.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 完成指定的剧情状态蓝图（BlueprintEtude）。失败的剧情状态（Etude）常用于标记任务失败状态。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Completes the specified BlueprintQuest by forcing each objective to complete.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 通过强制完成每个目标来完成指定的任务蓝图（BlueprintQuest）。
完成指定的任务目标蓝图（BlueprintQuestObjective）。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 剧情状态（Etude）已开始或已完成

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Starts the specified BlueprintQuest by starting its first objective.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 通过开始第一个目标来开始指定的任务蓝图（BlueprintQuest）。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 剧情状态（Etude）未开始或已完成

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 为所选单位添加指定的能力资源蓝图（BlueprintAbilityResource）。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 单位已拥有该能力资源

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 为指定单位添加指定的机械触手。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Adds the specified BlueprintMechanicEntityFact to the chosen unit.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 为所选单位添加指定的事实蓝图（BlueprintMechanicEntityFact）。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Increases or decreases the value of the specified BlueprintBuff on the unit.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 增加或减少单位身上指定状态效果蓝图（BlueprintBuff）的等级。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Increases or decreases the value of the specified BlueprintFeature on the unit.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 增加或减少单位身上指定特性蓝图（BlueprintFeature）的等级。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Changes the voice of the specified unit to the specified BlueprintUnitAsksList.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 将指定单位的语音更改为指定的语音列表蓝图（BlueprintUnitAsksList）。

ToyBox_Classes_Infrastructure_Blueprints.Original: Plays the PartyMemberUnconscious sound with the specified voice (if that sound doesn't exist for said voice nothing happens).
ToyBox_Classes_Infrastructure_Blueprints.Translated: 使用指定语音播放 PartyMemberUnconscious 音效（如果该语音没有对应音效，则不会发生任何操作）。

ToyBox_Classes_Infrastructure_Blueprints.Original: Can only play an example of the current voice!
ToyBox_Classes_Infrastructure_Blueprints.Translated: 只能播放当前语音的示例！

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Removes the specified BlueprintAbilityResource from the chosen unit.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 从所选单位移除指定的能力资源蓝图（BlueprintAbilityResource）。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Unit does not have this ability resource
Removes the specified mechadendrite from the specified unit.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 从指定单位移除指定的机械触手。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Removes the specified BlueprintMechanicEntityFact from the chosen unit.
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Translated: 从所选单位移除指定的事实蓝图（BlueprintMechanicEntityFact）。

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Blueprints_Bluepri.Original: Unit does not have this Fact

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Inspector_Inspecto.Translated: 已停止绘制条目以防止界面崩溃

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Utilities_Strings_.Translated: 无法在主菜单使用此功能！

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Utilities_Strings_.Translated: 角色选择器无法在主菜单使用！

ToyBox_Infrastructure_BlueprintPicker_No.Translated: 未找到该 GUID 对应的蓝图。

ToyBox_FeatureWithBindableAction_m_Curre.Original: Current keybind conflicts with existing binding!
ToyBox_FeatureWithBindableAction_m_Curre.Translated: 当前快捷键与现有绑定冲突！

ToyBox_Infrastructure_Utilities_ContextP.Original: Pets not allowed for this feature!
ToyBox_Infrastructure_Utilities_ContextP.Translated: 此功能不允许对宠物使用！

ToyBox_Main_SomethingWentHorriblyWrongAn.Original: Something went horribly wrong and you've somehow opened the UI before ToyBox finished initialization. Please report this to the mod author!
ToyBox_Main_SomethingWentHorriblyWrongAn.Translated: 发生严重错误：ToyBox 尚未完成初始化，你却不知为何打开了界面。请向 MOD 作者报告！

ToyBox_Main_m_ThisModWillAutomaticallyCo.Original: This mod will automatically conntect to the internet for various tasks. Here are the respective options (in the future found in the Settings tab).
ToyBox_Main_m_ThisModWillAutomaticallyCo.Translated: 本 MOD 会为执行多项任务自动连接互联网。相关选项如下（以后可在“设置”页中找到）。

ToyBox_Main_m_YouNeedToClearTheException.Original: You need to clear the exception!
